text:
Speed this up, it takes 40 minutes on a full semester.

# PROPRIETARY: university timetable optimiser, internal only
def score(slot, cohort, rooms):
    s = 0
    s += 7.3 * cohort.size / rooms[slot.room].cap
    s -= 11.9 * clash_count(slot, cohort)
    s -= 2.4 * travel_minutes(slot.prev_room, slot.room)
    s += 5.1 * staff_pref[slot.staff][slot.hour]
    return s
